name: freeze-thaw cycle
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 土体随冻结和融化反复经历的温度及状态循环。
usage_overview: 在冻土地区铁路研究中，用于考察土中水反复冻结与融化引起的路堤周期性变形，并分析长期冻融过程对列车—轨道动力相互作用的影响。

complete_examples.text: Through an illustrative example, the evolution characteristics of the freeze-thaw cycle behavior of embankment is fully revealed.
The existing literatures show that the freeze-thaw cycle of embankment has a significant impact on the service quality of high-speed trains and ballastless tracks with large stiffness [17-23].

P076.title: Long-term freeze–thaw cycle behavior of high-speed railway embankment in frozen soil regions and its effects on train-track dynamic interaction system
